description_en: Queries the compliance summary from the compliance evaluation result dimension of a rule in a specified account group
description_zh: 从指定账号组内规则的合规评估结果维度查询合规概要
name: GetAggregateResourceComplianceByConfigRule

parameters.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data
parameters.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据
parameters.name: compliance_type

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For information about how to obtain a rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain an account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the resource owner in the account group.
Specify either ResourceAccountId or ResourceOwnerId. We recommend that you use this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
账号组内待查询资源所属的阿里云账号ID。
参数ResourceAccountId和ResourceOwnerId二选一，推荐使用本参数
parameters.name: resource_account_id
